lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Hinge is set. Back cut now. Stay out of the lane.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Down. That's the day's count up by one. Next one.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Trunk's limbed. You take the top end, I'll section the butt.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Clean stump. Flat enough to set a mug on.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Wood doesn't cut itself. Small axe, small bites, same tree on the ground.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Lane clear behind you? I'm about to drop this one.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Felling, boss. Notch is in, hinge is even. She'll go where I put her.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Yard's full, chief. I can drop trees all day, but the cradle can't take another log.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Wet bark. Watch your footing on the trunk, it's like soap.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Last one before dark. Nobody starts another after this.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Forty percent down, give or take. I've been counting stumps on the walk out.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Rotten heart on this stump. Comes apart in handfuls. Easy money.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Dale, short sections on this one. No showing off with the long ones.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Big axe on a trunk this thick. Three swings to the hinge, then I'm counting.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Report, boss: I've dropped my share today and the next one's already notched.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Wind's pushing the crown. I'll wait for a lull before the back cut.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Waiting on the lane. Someone's bucking right where this one wants to land.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Priya's notches are getting cleaner. Don't anyone tell her I said so.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Pinched the cut. Wedge it, don't wrestle it.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: You've out-talked me. The count says otherwise.

lines.speaker: EMP-01
lines.text: Somewhere. Never found it. Next one, Joan.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Timber, mate. Always wanted to say that and actually mean it.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Cutting this into sandwich lengths. Log lengths. I meant log lengths. I'm hungry.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: This one's leaning like it's had a long lunch. Watch the left side, mate.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Stump's coming out. Roots down here like a plate of noodles.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Bucking, mate. Shorter pieces, so nobody needs me to carry every single one.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Reckon I've out-chopped you this morning, Marta.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Can't hear myself think over this thing. Probably for the best.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Rain down my collar. Tree doesn't care, so neither do I. Mostly.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Track's blocked, mate. Sections all over it between here and the next marked tree.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: No, Biscuit, the stump's not a snack. I'll find you something after.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Getting dark, mate. Two more cuts and then I'm thinking about dinner.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: That's one I've dropped today. Feels like I've earned a second breakfast.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Sap's on everything, mate. Gloves, sleeves, eyebrows somehow.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Knot in the middle of this trunk like a fist. Going round it.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Know what this job needs, mate? A sandwich every hundred trees. Just putting it out there.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Twenty days in and my arms finally stopped complaining. Now it's my back's turn.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: More sky than trees now. You can see the water from the cutting line.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Stand behind me, mate. Not because it's dangerous. I just block the wind.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Dry ground today. This stump's letting go easier than yesterday's.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Me? Show off? I just like a log with some heft to it.

lines.speaker: EMP-02
lines.text: Notch looks good, mate. You don't need me. I just like being asked.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Lean is about ten degrees east. Notch goes on that side.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Is that crown hung up on the next tree? Look at the top branches before you go in.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Tight rings on this one. Slow growth, very hard wood.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Stump is level. I checked it with the axe handle, which counts as a tool.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Report, boss: everything I felled today went down in the planned direction. One needed a wedge.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Sectioning the trunk, boss. Even lengths, so they stack flat on the decks.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: The wind has gone round to the north. Should we check the fall directions again?

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Marta's hinge on that last one was two fingers thick, exactly. I'm copying it.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: This section will roll downhill when it comes free. Could you stand uphill, please?

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Rain makes the bark slick and the cut cleaner. I'll take that trade.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Three main roots. The downhill one gets cut last.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: I'm waiting, boss. My fall zone overlaps where someone is bucking. Two minutes, perhaps.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: A quarter of the island is cleared. The wind reaches the cutting line differently now. Have you felt it?

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Back cut level with the notch. Hinge holding. Good.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Too loud for questions while the saw runs. I'll write them down for later.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Light's going. I can't judge the lean properly in this. I'd rather stop.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Dry wood splinters at the hinge. Leave it slightly thicker today.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Something moved in the uphill trees when that one landed. Thirty metres off. Birds, most likely.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: You can read drought years in the rings, boss. This tree lived through three of them.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Clear. I checked the lean twice. It wants to go left anyway.

lines.speaker: EMP-03
lines.text: Five hours. I counted. The cabin roof drips on the left side.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Okay. Notch, then back cut. Notch, then back cut. Okay.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Is everyone clear? Sorry, I'm going to drop this now. Is that okay?

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Cut that one a bit crooked. Sorry. It'll still carry.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Is it dusk already? How long before we should head in, do you think?

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Felling, boss. Slowly. But it's going the right way, I think.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Stumps are like a stuck gearbox. Find the right angle and they give.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: I dropped one on my own today. Ana's getting a whole paragraph about it.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Dale, could you check my notch before I cut? Sorry. Just once more.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Rain's making the trunk shift. Sorry, I'm wedging it first.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: The way through is blocked with logs, boss. I can't reach the next tree from here. Sorry.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Can't hear anything over the saw. That's fine. That's completely fine.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: I think I'm getting faster at this? Is that true, or am I imagining it?

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Wind keeps moving the top. I'll wait. Waiting is allowed, right?

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: These lengths would fit the truck bed perfectly. Not that I'm thinking about the truck.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Report, boss: one down from me today, no trouble. Sorry it isn't more.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Only a few days left on the contract. I've started counting them, like Marta does trees.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Did that stump just creak on its own? It's settling. Stumps settle. Sorry.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Half the island's cleared. From the truck you can see right across to the far shore now.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Felled that one without asking anyone first. Nobody tell me if it was wrong.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Uphill. Yes. Sorry, I hadn't noticed the slope.

lines.speaker: EMP-04
lines.text: Thanks, Dale. That actually helps. Sorry for using you as a wall.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Down she goes. Like last orders on a busy night.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Pass me the far end, love. I'll make it into something a person can lift.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Fall line clear, sunshine? I'd hate to flatten anyone before lunch.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Cutting, boss-love. Steady, not glamorous. Like most good shifts.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Company pays by the tree, boss-love. I told the trees. They weren't impressed.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Marta, you've not stopped since sunrise. Do you have an off switch?

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Stubborn stump. Reminds me of a regular I had. Wouldn't leave either.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Wet sections, wet gloves, wet me. Glamorous life, this.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Light's going, love. Let's tidy this one up and call it a day.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: That's me on the board for today. Someone owes me a cup of tea.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Yard's chock-a-block, boss-love. We're cutting faster than that fire can eat.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Tomas dropped that last one clean as anything. Did you see his face after?

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Knotty bit in the middle. I'll cut either side and let it be the fire's problem.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Wind's having opinions about this tree. Let's wait till it's finished talking.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Ten days in. My hands have finally stopped asking what I've done to them.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: How'd you sleep, love? You're cutting like someone who didn't.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Hardly any forest left. I'll miss the shade, if nothing else.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Report, boss-love: trees down, sections cut, nobody hurt. Best kind of report there is.

lines.speaker: EMP-05
lines.text: Big axe on a stump. Like buttering toast with a cleaver. Works, though.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: Tree coming down! Clear the lane!

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: She's going. Everyone stand back.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: Next trunk's ready to section when you are.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: Stump's done. Moving on to the next.

lines.speaker: trait:hard_working
lines.text: One more before the break. There's always room for one more.

lines.speaker: trait:timid
lines.text: It's getting late. Can we finish this one and head in?

lines.speaker: trait:observant
lines.text: Dead branch up top. Watch it doesn't drop when the trunk moves.

lines.speaker: trait:level_headed
lines.text: No rush. Get the hinge right and the rest follows.

lines.speaker: trait:stronger
lines.text: Leave the long sections whole. I can manage them.

lines.speaker: trait:sociable
lines.text: Good rhythm today. We should work the same lane more often.

lines.speaker: trait:skeptical
lines.text: Not every creak is a warning. Old wood creaks when you cut it.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: Bark's slippery. Mind the blade on the wet side.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: Too gusty to drop anything. I'll section what's already down.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: Nothing marked near me, boss. Point me at a tree and I'll drop it.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: Can't cut with bare hands, boss. I need something off the tool rack first.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: Lane's occupied. I'll hold off until they're out of the fall zone.

lines.speaker: trait:reliable_driver
lines.text: Once this lot's sectioned, I'd happily drive it in myself.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: Mud all round the stump. Roots are greasy today.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: The line's moving. You can see daylight through the first stands now.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: Short, even lengths. Easier on whoever's carrying.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: Dusk. Finish the cut and leave the rest for morning.

lines.speaker: trait:observant
lines.text: Fresh scrape marks on that root. Something's been digging here recently.

lines.speaker: trait:hard_working
lines.text: Felled, sectioned and ready to haul, boss. Point me at the next.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: Saw's running. If you need me, shout, then shout louder.

lines.speaker: trait:timid
lines.text: Would you watch the top while I cut? Just in case it twists.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: Late in the contract and the trunks don't get any lighter.

lines.speaker: trait:level_headed
lines.text: Gust coming through. Pull the saw out, wait, start again.

lines.speaker: any
lines.text: Coming. Mark where you want the first cut.
